summary: Request to add methods to WorkflowImplementationOptions for setting ChildWorkflowOptions, providing consistent configuration alongside existing ActivityOptions and NexusServiceOptions.
userImpact: Developers would benefit from a consistent API to set default child workflow options across all workflow implementations.
proposedFix: Add setChildWorkflowOptions(Map<String, ChildWorkflowOptions> options) and setDefaultChildWorkflowOptions(ChildWorkflowOptions options) methods to WorkflowImplementationOptions.
keyQuote: It would be great if there was a method to set `ChildWorkflowOptions` in the same way
